note: Stage 3 closing level before the stage test: number maze with mixed two digit adding and subtracting. Four teaching scenes — the cat at the maze gate with twenty-five plus twelve, the fork with the question and a one second pause, the answer with the cat stepping forward, then a two step chain thirty plus fifteen minus ten. Answer phase: which way / drag the answer of a chain / find the wrong path.

lines.text: Help the cat find the way! Twenty-five plus twelve.
First, thirty plus fifteen is forty-five. Then, forty-five minus ten is thirty-five.
Twenty plus ten minus five. Drag the answer.
